openai_compatible.protocol: POST chat/completions, Authorization: Bearer <key>, SSE chunks data: { choices: [{ delta: ... }] }

anthropic.protocol: POST /v1/messages, x-api-key: <key>, anthropic-version, SSE events message_start, content_block_delta, message_delta

gemini.protocol: POST :generateContent?key=<key>, contents: [{ parts: [{ text: ... }] }], candidate response

custom.protocol: Configurable base URL, custom auth headers, OpenAI-compatible or direct JSON envelope
